experiments.title: Seeing Your First Satellite Signal
experiments.description: Receive a known satellite signal and watch it move across the SDR waterfall during a pass.

experiments.title: Measuring Satellite Doppler Shift
experiments.description: Record the frequency change as a satellite approaches, passes overhead and moves away.

experiments.title: Receiving a Radiosonde
experiments.description: Decode weather-balloon telemetry including position, altitude and atmospheric data.

experiments.title: Tracking a Radiosonde to Landing
experiments.description: Follow a weather balloon through ascent, burst and descent and predict its landing point.

experiments.title: Receiving CubeSat Telemetry
experiments.description: Receive and decode telemetry from amateur, university and experimental CubeSats.

experiments.title: Receiving Satellite SSTV Images
experiments.description: Receive slow-scan television images transmitted from suitable spacecraft or amateur satellite events.

experiments.title: Receiving HRPT Weather Satellites
experiments.description: Receive high-resolution weather data directly from polar-orbiting satellites using the Discovery Dish.

experiments.title: Creating Weather Images From Raw Satellite Data
experiments.description: Decode HRPT data into visible, infrared and other weather imagery.

experiments.title: Tracking a Weather Satellite With the Dish
experiments.description: Automatically move the dish in azimuth and elevation to follow a satellite pass.

experiments.title: Building a Daily Weather Satellite Archive
experiments.description: Automatically receive, decode and store images from useful satellite passes.

experiments.title: Comparing Weather Images Over Time
experiments.description: Compare consecutive satellite passes to observe changing cloud systems and weather fronts.

experiments.title: Measuring the Discovery Dish Beamwidth
experiments.description: Sweep a strong source through the dish beam and plot received power against pointing angle.

experiments.title: Identifying an Unknown Satellite by Doppler
experiments.description: Match an unknown signal's Doppler curve and pass time against predicted spacecraft.

experiments.title: Building a Satellite RF Logbook
experiments.description: Automatically record frequency, SNR, bandwidth, Doppler, time, satellite and pointing information.

experiments.title: Hunting Transit 5B-5
experiments.description: Attempt to receive signals associated with the 1964 Transit navigation satellite.

experiments.title: Hunting Zombie Satellites
experiments.description: Search for old or abandoned spacecraft that continue or unexpectedly resume transmitting.

experiments.title: Searching for LES-1
experiments.description: Attempt to detect the famous 1965 Lincoln Experimental Satellite.

experiments.title: Building an Ancient Satellite Catalogue
experiments.description: Catalogue historic spacecraft, frequencies, orbital information and your own reception attempts.

experiments.title: Passive Satellite Spectrum Survey
experiments.description: Survey satellite bands and document what RF activity appears in each part of the spectrum.

experiments.title: Finding Satellites Without Knowing What to Look For
experiments.description: Record wide sections of spectrum and identify unknown moving signals afterwards.

experiments.title: Turning the Discovery Dish Into a Ku-Band Receiver
experiments.description: Add an LNB so the dish can receive signals around 10–12 GHz and downconvert them for an SDR.

experiments.title: Receiving QO-100
experiments.description: Receive the geostationary amateur satellite QO-100 using the dish and Ku-band LNB.

experiments.title: Exploring the QO-100 Transponder
experiments.description: Observe SSB, CW, digital modes and beacon activity across the QO-100 transponder.

experiments.title: Receiving a Geostationary Satellite Beacon
experiments.description: Detect and monitor a stable RF beacon from a geostationary spacecraft.

experiments.title: Finding Geostationary Satellites With an SDR
experiments.description: Scan the geostationary arc and identify satellites from their beacons and transponders.

experiments.title: Measuring Geostationary Satellite Drift
experiments.description: Monitor subtle changes in beacon frequency or apparent position over long periods.

experiments.title: Observing Inclined-Orbit Satellites
experiments.description: Observe geostationary spacecraft whose orbital inclination causes predictable daily movement.

experiments.title: Exploring Satellite TV Signals With an SDR
experiments.description: Examine DVB-S/S2 carriers, bandwidth and transponder structure using the dish and LNB.

experiments.title: Watching Iridium Satellites Cross the Sky
experiments.description: Observe Iridium satellite signal strength and Doppler as individual spacecraft pass.

experiments.title: Mapping Iridium Doppler Curves
experiments.description: Record multiple passes and compare measured Doppler against orbital predictions.

experiments.title: Receiving GPS and Galileo With an SDR
experiments.description: Capture raw GNSS signals rather than relying on a conventional GPS receiver.

experiments.title: Building a Software GPS Receiver
experiments.description: Use raw IQ data to acquire GNSS satellites and calculate a navigation solution in software.

experiments.title: Measuring GNSS Satellite Doppler
experiments.description: Measure and compare GNSS carrier Doppler against predicted satellite motion.

experiments.title: Receiving Reflected GPS Signals From the Sea
experiments.description: Attempt to detect GNSS signals reflected from the sea surface.

experiments.title: GNSS Reflectometry and Sea State
experiments.description: Compare direct and reflected GNSS signals to investigate changes caused by sea conditions.

experiments.title: Aircraft Scatter
experiments.description: Detect changes in distant radio signals caused by reflections from passing aircraft.

experiments.title: Meteor Scatter
experiments.description: Detect brief radio reflections from ionised meteor trails.

experiments.title: Observing Broadband LEO Constellations
experiments.description: Measure spectrum occupancy, bandwidth, Doppler and pass behaviour of modern LEO constellations.

experiments.title: Mapping the RF Sky
experiments.description: Automatically point the dish around the sky and map RF power and spectrum occupancy by direction.

experiments.title: Building an Automated Space RF Observatory
experiments.description: Combine dish tracking, SDRs, antennas, satellite predictions, recording, decoding and a database into an unattended station.
